archive_observations.history_observation: The archive's .history tree exposes many README revisions and source-code history snapshots from December 2025, but its listed archive contents still do not include the PP1-PP5 preprocessing notebooks or the Reduced_dendrites intermediate forest.

proven: The January 2026 archived software release preserves Point_data and downstream analysis artifacts as a publication snapshot.
The release archive does not preserve the preprocessing notebooks or Reduced_dendrites intermediates needed to recover the exact December producer from that release.
not_proven: Absence from this release archive does not prove the producer never existed; it establishes only that the publication snapshot does not preserve it.

relation_to_current_boundary.effect: Strengthens the conclusion that the public publication package preserves the derived artifact and downstream consumers while omitting the upstream producer/intermediate morphology materialization.
